title: Ali Salam Karna Bhool Gaya! 😮 | Salam Kyun Karte Hain? | Islamic Cartoon for Kids
description:
Chhota Ali khel kar ghar aaya, lekin Salam karna bhool gaya! Dadu ne pyaar se samjhaya ki hum Salam kyun karte hain. 🤲

📖 Hadith:
Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ki Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya:
"Tum Jannat mein dakhil nahi hoge jab tak imaan na lao, aur imaan wale nahi banoge jab tak aapas mein mohabbat na karo. Kya main tumhein aisi cheez na bataun jis se tum aapas mein mohabbat karne lago? Aapas mein Salam phailao."
— Sahih Muslim 54 (Sahih)

📖 Quran:
"Jab tumhein Salam kiya jaye to usse behtar jawab do, ya wahi lauta do."
— Surah An-Nisa 4:86

Salam ka matlab: "Tum par Allah ki salamati ho" — yeh ek pyaari dua hai.

Apne bachchon ko yeh video zaroor dikhayein. Ali aur Dadu ki aur kahaniyon ke liye Hidayah ko subscribe karein ❤️
